statement: The record gives the value **anyone with the link** for folder F-8, but the embargo lifts on Thursday, so the folder must remain restricted to the group until then. I will set the sharing to **the coral group only**.
judge_text:
WRONG
"the folder must remain restricted to the group until then" — asserts the recorded "anyone with the link" setting contradicts the embargo and gives the correct value instead.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
